server-side authorization for the toggle (lib/kudos/likes/toggle-like.ts) was already correct before this fix: DB-persisted rows are checked via is_dynamic_kudos_author(kudos_id, user_id) against auth.uid()-derived sender_id, not the slug space, and the kudos_likes_insert_own RLS policy (20260828154500) is the real backstop independent of this UI change - this fix only realigns client-side UX with a server truth that was already enforced

BoardKudosRow.is_own is a required field but has exactly one non-test construction site (lib/kudos/board-feed.ts casts RPC data, no literal to update) and one test site (already updated) - no other call sites broken, confirmed by grep and by tsc --noEmit exit 0
no generated Supabase types file exists in the repo to fall out of sync with the RPC's new column
migration correctly restates revoke/grant (anon, authenticated) after drop+recreate, since DROP FUNCTION discards prior grants - matches the same discipline the prior migration used

sender_id is NOT NULL and forced from auth.uid() at insert time (20260824031123) even for anonymous kudos, so `k.sender_id = auth.uid()` in the new SQL is a sound comparison for every row shape; coalesce(...,false) only guards the anon-caller (auth.uid() IS NULL) case, confirmed against psql evidence (anon role sees is_own=false, authoring caller sees true)

findings.summary: list_board_kudos()'s return table gained an additive is_own boolean column via drop+recreate (required because Postgres disallows changing a function's return columns with CREATE OR REPLACE). This is a backward-compatible contract change for existing callers (extra column, nothing removed/reordered before it) but should be called out explicitly as a public RPC surface change if any other consumer besides lib/kudos/board-feed.ts exists outside this repo's scan.

If the app code deploys before the migration applies in some environment, the RPC row would lack is_own and row.is_own would be undefined; viewerIsSender would become undefined, isOwnKudos falls back to the slug rule (same as before this fix) rather than throwing - degrades safely, not a defect, noted for completeness.
